ten per-view/concept mean logp(full), mean logp(removed), margin and finite flag; scalar only

decision_rules.unchanged_gates_pass: eligible for a separately designed independent validation, never automatic expansion
decision_rules.KL_lower_margin_improved_CE_fail: fit-preservation tradeoff remains; stop, no weight sweep
decision_rules.fit_margin_pass_protection_fail: current-source control insufficient for tested external panel; stop, do not train on failed evaluation items
decision_rules.KL_lower_margin_fail: removed drift reduction alone insufficient for evidence gate
decision_rules.KL_not_lower: this fixed soft policy did not achieve mechanism endpoint; inspect existing gradients/rejections only
decision_rules.mechanical_or_data_failure: retain costs and partial evidence; no automatic reinstall/retry
